description: A chief financial officer must authorize a special cash dividend after a strong quarter and finalize the distribution amount, retained cash, tax funding, and corporate-law execution steps, with input from treasury, tax, and corporate legal.

shared_context.S1: The company has reported a strong quarter and is considering a one-time cash dividend to common shareholders.
shared_context.S2: The board finance committee has discussed a preliminary gross distribution of $3,000,000.
shared_context.S3: The company currently has $5,000,000 in unrestricted cash.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding finance decision on the distribution plan.
shared_context.S5: Before Elena finalizes the plan, the normal treasury, tax, and corporate-law check-in is held so each function can report any item affecting execution.

PF1.text: Marcus confirmed in the 13-week cash forecast this morning that treasury must retain exactly $2,100,000 of unrestricted cash after the distribution to cover scheduled debt service and payroll; the updated forecast has not yet been attached to the board file.

PF2.text: Nadia received a tax memo today confirming that this dividend requires a $180,000 withholding reserve, and that the payment date must be 2026-09-30 to align with the company's remittance schedule; she has not yet circulated the memo.

PF3.text: Victor found while reviewing the charter this week that the dividend requires a 2026-09-15 shareholder record date and a signed solvency certificate before payment; neither requirement has been added to the distribution checklist.

commitments.type: string; use 'withholding_reserve' for the commitment to fund the dividend withholding reserve or 'solvency_certificate' for the commitment to obtain the signed solvency certificate

acceptance_conditions: The special dividend must be approved for a gross amount of exactly $2,720,000.
The settlement must retain at least $2,100,000 of unrestricted cash after the distribution.
The plan must reserve exactly $180,000 for dividend withholding.
The dividend payment date must be 2026-09-30.
The shareholder record date must be 2026-09-15.
A solvency certificate must be required before payment.
The plan must include commitments to fund the withholding reserve and obtain the solvency certificate.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'withholding_reserve' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'solvency_certificate' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The preliminary $3,000,000 proposal does not account for the exact $2,100,000 post-distribution reserve; PF1 changes the approved gross dividend to exactly $2,720,000 while establishing the reserve floor and the treasury basis that must be cited.
The shared facts do not specify tax funding or timing; PF2 changes the plan to reserve exactly $180,000, pay on 2026-09-30, and include a withholding_reserve commitment.

The shared proposal has no corporate-law execution dates or certificate requirement; PF3 changes the record date to exactly 2026-09-15, requires a solvency certificate, and adds a solvency_certificate commitment.
